newsitem.title: UK: IBCA maintains Costain Group Plc ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA maintains Costain Group Plc ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Monday it had maintained the short-term C and long-term CCC ratings of Costain Group Plc.
IBCA said 74 million stg new equity in July provided only short-term relief for Costain whose Middle East construction operations had larger-than-expected second-half 1996 losses.
"Although all other construction and civil engineering activities are reported to be profitable currently, long-term earnings stability still appears elusive," a statement said.
"The sale of U.S. Coal and the group's interest in the Spitalfields property development will boost cash as well as remove losses and free management time.
"The new majority owner, Intria, appears committed and Costain's banks have again shown their support."
